program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((cmd (at g 0 0)))
    (define (apply-cmd grid code)
      (cond [(= code 2) grid]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 4) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [else (rotate-ccw grid)]))
    (let* ((cleaned (set-cell g 0 0 0))
           (mask (grid-from-fn (rows cleaned) (cols cleaned)
                   (lambda (r c) (if (= (at cleaned r c) 0) 0 1))))
           (objs (sort (objects mask 0)
                       (lambda (a b)
                         (cond [(not (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))]
                               [(not (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))]
                               [else (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))]))))
           (obj (first objs)))
      (apply-cmd (subgrid cleaned (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj)) cmd))))
